weaknesses.title: LINEAT/MIDFILE bare numeric var is form error (need expr parens)
weaknesses.detail: Same trap as HEADFILE: SYS LINEAT p i fails unknown form 'i'; SYS LINEAT p (i) works. Parameterized incident peels must remember (expr).
weaknesses.repro: LET i=1; SYS LINEAT p i → parse fail

weaknesses.title: Negative LINEAT/MIDFILE index silently clamps to 0
weaknesses.detail: LINEAT p -1 returns line 0 with OK=1 N=1 I=0; MIDFILE -1 starts at 0. Agents cannot detect underflow — looks like a valid first line.
weaknesses.repro: SYS LINEAT p -1 → LAST=L0 not miss

weaknesses.title: LINEAT OOB OK=1 N=0 but missing file OK=0
weaknesses.detail: Out-of-range index is soft success-empty; unreadable path is hard soft-fail. Agents checking only OK miss OOB; checking only N conflate miss types.
weaknesses.repro: LINEAT fs 99 OK=1 N=0; LINEAT gone 0 OK=0

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON window bag glues lines
weaknesses.detail: Recurring: frame1 initframe2 workframe3 ERROR boom without separators.

weaknesses.title: MIDFILE vs MIDLINES vs WINDOW bag ops are easy to confuse
weaknesses.detail: MIDFILE is file path; MIDLINES/WINDOW are in-memory bag slices. Wrong op peels STATE bag not dump on disk.
weaknesses.repro: MIDLINES on path string vs MIDFILE path

weaknesses.title: 0-based only — no 1-based LINEAT1 / human line numbers
weaknesses.detail: Stack dumps and editor UIs are 1-based; agents must subtract one. No FILELINE1 alias.

weaknesses.title: WRITE omits trailing NL on single-line LINE plate
weaknesses.detail: cat -A LINE.txt shows frame3 ERROR boom without final $.

weaknesses.title: No MIDFILE around-index primitive
weaknesses.detail: Context window requires agent arithmetic (clamp start, want=2r+1) + dual LINEAT. Common incident pattern not first-class.
weaknesses.repro: around action is pure agent glue

workarounds: Always SYS LINEAT path (idx) and SYS MIDFILE path (start) (count)
Treat LINEAT_N==0 as miss even when OK==1
Reject idx < 0 at agent layer before call
Read WINDOW.txt plate not PRINT_JSON for multiline
